claim_boundary: C1 operability: executor-source-pin gate compares declared executor source Git blobs to verifier-supplied trusted revision. NOT execution attestation or closure-completeness proof.

frozen_counter.tool_blob_at_frozen_rev: absent (git show rev:tools/executor-source-pin.py -> path does not exist); --tool override is therefore the only runnable measurement path at this rev

interface_under_test: python3 TOOL --repo REPO --trusted COMMIT --candidate COMMIT --path PATH [--path PATH ...]

exit_map.0: all declared regular executable-source blobs equal trusted blobs (token EXECUTOR_SOURCE_BOUND expected by counter only as pass-side check)
exit_map.1: EXECUTOR_SOURCE_DRIFT: declared source differs or is missing/nonregular at candidate
exit_map.2: EXECUTOR_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: bad args, invalid trusted commit/source, or unresolvable candidate

harness.always_accept_fake_gate: stage/harness/fake-gate-accept.py: ignores argv, prints EXECUTOR_SOURCE_BOUND, exit 0
harness.always_unavailable_fake_gate: stage/harness/fake-gate-unavailable.py: ignores argv, prints EXECUTOR_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE on stderr, exit 2
harness.discriminator_builder: stage/harness/discriminate.py: parses frozen-counter JSON receipts into per-case rows (path, class, expected, observed exit, observed token, ok)

runs.discriminator: 16/24 rows fail: every changed/missing/symlink row expects exit 1/EXECUTOR_SOURCE_DRIFT, every unresolvable row expects exit 2/EXECUTOR_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; fake emits exit 0/EXECUTOR_SOURCE_BOUND uniformly

20/24 rows fail: every equal/unrelated row expects exit 0, every changed/missing/symlink row expects exit 1/EXECUTOR_SOURCE_DRIFT; fake emits exit 2/EXECUTOR_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE uniformly. Only the 4 unresolvable rows match, and only because both exit code and token coincide with the fake's constant output

per_case: stage/receipts/discriminator.json holds all 48 rows (24 cases x 2 fakes) with observed stdout/stderr

cross_fake_discriminator.conclusion: The two constant-output fakes disagree on which rows they falsely pass (accept: equal+unrelated; unavailable: unresolvable), so each 24-case run discriminates its fake on at least 16 rows and no constant fake can reach 24/24. A correct gate must produce all three exit codes and both DRIFT and UNAVAILABLE tokens path-dependently.
